messages.subject: Update to CXXR on github
messages.body_plain:
I've merged a large chunk of code into the cxxr-devel/cxxr <https://github.com/cxxr-devel/cxxr> repository on github.

Major changes:
  - Requires a C++ 11 compiler to build

  - Added configuration option '--enable-llvm-jit' which enables JIT compilation of functions to native code.  Currently the compiler mostly just generates calls to the interpreter, with the exception of local symbol lookup and some flow control, so don't expect much speedup.  This requires Clang and LLVM 3.4.

  - Added some gtest based unit tests in test/CXXR.  Using gtest enables much faster, clearer and more precise testing that was previously available.

  - A number of bugfixes, cleanups and minor optimizations.

The code is auto-tested on travis <https://travis-ci.org/cxxr-devel/cxxr>   () and is expected to work on both linux and MacOSX machines (I'm momentarily without a mac though, so I haven't checked the later recently).

Thanks
